forage.note: Spring Onions grow in a patch in the south of Cindersap Forest.
Coral washes up in the tide pools east of the repaired bridge.
Sea Urchins wash up in the tide pools east of the repaired bridge.
Cave Carrots appear on Mines floors.

quests.name: Introductions
quests.text: It would be a nice gesture to introduce yourself around town. Some people might be anxious to meet the new farmer.
quests.task: 28 people greeted.
quests.reward: 100 Friendship points (2/5 of a heart) with every known NPC

quests.name: How to Win Friends
quests.text: Giving gifts is a great way to build friendships. Learn each person's individual tastes and you'll be popular in no time.
quests.task: Give anyone a gift.

quests.name: Getting Started
quests.text: If you want to become a farmer, you have to start with the basics. Use your hoe to till the soil, then use a seed packet on the tilled soil to sow a crop. Water every day until the crop is ready for harvest.
quests.task: Cultivate and harvest a parsnip.

quests.name: To The Beach
quests.text: Someone named Willy invited you to visit the beach south of town. He says he has something to give you.
quests.task: Visit the beach south of town before 5:00pm.

quests.name: Raising Animals
quests.text: Robin, the local carpenter, lives north of town. In exchange for raw materials and money, she'll construct new buildings on your farm. You'll need her to build a coop or barn so that you can raise animals.
quests.task: Build a Coop. Note that this quest does not require the player to purchase animals.

quests.name: Advancement
quests.text: As you gain experience you'll discover new crafting recipes to increase profit and make life easier. A Scarecrow, for example, will prevent crows from snacking on your precious crops.
quests.task: Reach Farming level 1 and craft a Scarecrow.

quests.name: Explore The Mine
quests.text: There's an old mine shaft in the mountains north of town. There could be valuable minerals inside, but Marlon hinted that it might be dangerous.
quests.task: Reach level 5 in the mines.

quests.name: Deeper In The Mine
quests.text: It seems that the mine elevator is still functional. It will allow you to quickly return to any elevator doors you've discovered. A deeper expedition might be in order.
quests.task: Reach level 40 in the mines.

quests.name: To The Bottom?
quests.text: So far, there's no sign of the bottom. How low does it go?
quests.task: Reach the bottom of the mine.

quests.name: Archaeology
quests.text: Gunther asked if you'd consider donating any new artifacts or minerals you find to the museum. He says he'll compensate you by way of occasional rare goods.
quests.start: Enter the Museum with a mineral or artifact in inventory.
quests.task: Donate an item to the Museum.

quests.name: Rat Problem
quests.text: There's something odd going on in the Community Center... Investigate the Community Center.
quests.start: Trigger the initial Community Center cutscene by entering Pelican Town from the Bus Stop between 8am and 1pm on a sunny day (Spring 5+)
quests.task: Enter the Community Center and examine the Golden Scroll in the Crafts Room.
quests.reward: The following morning, a letter from the Wizard arrives in the mail, triggering the "Meet the Wizard" quest.
quests.tip: Walk into Pelican Town from the Bus Stop between 8am and 1pm on a sunny day.

quests.name: Meet The Wizard
quests.text: You received a letter from the local wizard. He claims to have information regarding the old community center.
quests.start: The morning after the player examines the first golden scroll in the Community Center, they receive a letter from the Wizard saying he has information.
quests.task: Enter the wizard's tower.
quests.reward: The Wizard gives the player a potion that allows them to read the language of the Junimos.

quests.name: Forging Ahead
quests.text: If you're going to keep mining you should build a furnace.
quests.start: Morning after collecting a Copper Ore, Clint visits and gives the player the Furnace blueprints.
quests.task: Craft a Furnace.

quests.name: Smelting
quests.text: Now that you've built a furnace, you can smelt some metal. According to Clint's instructions, if you place 5 copper ore and 1 piece of coal in the furnace, it should produce a copper bar.
quests.task: Use the crafted furnace to smelt a copper bar.

quests.name: Initiation
quests.text: If you can slay 10 slimes, you'll have earned your place in the Adventurer's Guild.
quests.start: Mailbox, morning after reaching floor 5 in the Mines.
quests.task: 10 Slimes slain in the Mines, Secret Woods, or on the Farm.
quests.reward: Get to enter the Adventurer's Guild

quests.name: Robin's Lost Axe
quests.text: Robin lost her favorite axe. The last time she remembers using it, she was cutting wood south of Marnie's ranch.
quests.task: Find Robin's lost axe. Can be found near the Sewer Pipe in Cindersap Forest.

quests.name: Jodi's Request
quests.text: Jodi needs a fresh cauliflower for a recipe she's making. She's asking you to bring her one.
quests.task: Bring Jodi a Cauliflower.

quests.name: Mayor's "Shorts"
quests.text: Mayor Lewis has lost his purple "shorts". He's asking you to find and return them...Discreetly.
quests.task: Find and return Mayor Lewis' purple shorts. Can be found in Marnie's bedroom, or by placing a staircase inside Lewis' bedroom and following the path.

quests.name: Blackberry Basket
quests.text: It's blackberry season, but Linus can't find his basket! He's asking you to help him find it. He has no idea where it is.
quests.task: Find Linus' basket and return it to him. It's in the Backwoods near the entrance to the tunnel, which is to the left of the bus stop.

quests.name: Marnie's Request
quests.text: Marnie came by the farm and asked if you'd bring her a cave carrot. She's trying to train her goats to speak, and cave carrot is their favorite snack.
quests.start: She visits the farm house after the player is at 3 Friendship hearts with her.
quests.task: Bring a Cave Carrot into Marnie's shop.

quests.name: Pam Is Thirsty
quests.text: Pam is hankerin' for a pale ale. Regular old beer won't do. You can brew one yourself if you have hops and a keg.
quests.task: Bring Pam a pale ale.

quests.name: A Dark Reagent
quests.text: The wizard wants you to descend into the mines and fetch him a Void Essence. He needs it for some kind of dark magic.
quests.task: Bring the Wizard a Void Essence.

quests.name: Cow's Delight
quests.text: Marnie wants to give her cows a special treat. She's asking for a single bunch of amaranth.
quests.task: Bring Marnie one bunch of Amaranth.

quests.name: The Skull Key
quests.text: You found a strange looking key in the bottom of the mines.
quests.start: Reach the bottom floor of the Mines.
quests.task: Discover the purpose of the Skull Key.
quests.reward: Access to the Skull Cavern in the Desert

quests.name: Crop Research
quests.text: Demetrius needs a fresh melon for his research.
quests.task: Bring Demetrius a melon.

quests.name: Knee Therapy
quests.text: George needs a hot pepper to soothe his aching knee.
quests.task: Bring George a hot pepper.

quests.name: Robin's Request
quests.text: Robin needs 10 pieces of Hardwood.
quests.task: Bring Robin 10 Hardwood.

quests.name: Qi's Challenge
quests.text: You've been challenged to reach level 25 in the skull cavern. You've been promised a substantial reward if you're successful.
quests.start: Received by mail the day after entering the Skull Cavern.
quests.task: Reach level 25 in the Skull Cavern.
quests.reward: 10000g, delivered by mail the next day

quests.name: The Mysterious Qi
quests.text: Within a secret lock-box, you found a note with peculiar instructions. It's signed by a 'Mr. Qi'.
quests.start: Put a Battery Pack in the lock-box in the tunnel next to the bus stop.
quests.task: Leave a Rainbow Shell in the box at the train platform.

quests.name: The Mysterious Qi (2)
quests.text: You found another note written by 'Mr. Qi'. The request is even more unusual this time.
quests.task: Place 10 beets inside Mayor Lewis' fridge.

quests.name: The Mysterious Qi (3)
quests.text: You've found yet another strange note within the Mayor's fridge. This time, the instructions are more cryptic.
quests.task: "Give the sand dragon his final meal." (Put a Solar Essence in the sand dragon's mouth at the Desert.)

quests.name: The Mysterious Qi (4)
quests.text: You found another note in the sand dragon's eye. It seems Mr. Qi's strange scavenger hunt has come to an end.
quests.task: Inspect the lumber pile beside the Farmhouse.
quests.reward: Club Card, which grants access to the Casino in the Oasis.

quests.name: Carving Pumpkins
quests.text: Caroline wants to carve a pumpkin with her daughter. She asked you to bring her one from the farm.
quests.task: Bring Caroline a pumpkin.

quests.name: A Winter Mystery
quests.text: You encountered a suspicious looking figure by the bus stop. When it saw you, it fled toward town. Could there be a clue to its whereabouts?
quests.start: After triggering the cutscene by entering the Bus Stop from the Farm during Winter between 6am and 4pm.
quests.task: Interact with the bush to the right of the playground in Pelican Town.
quests.tip: Leave the Farm toward the Bus Stop in winter between 6am and 4pm.

quests.name: Strange Note
quests.text: You found a note, barely legible, asking you to bring "may-pal serrup" to the "seecrit wuds".
quests.task: Enter the Secret Woods between 6am and 7pm with Maple Syrup in inventory to trigger a cutscene.

quests.name: Cryptic Note
quests.text: You found a note that reads, "Someone is waiting for you on level 100 in the Skull Cavern."
quests.task: Reach level 100 in the Skull Cavern.
quests.reward: Mr. Qi awards the player with "iridium snake milk", which permanently increases the player's health by 25 points.

quests.name: Fresh Fruit
quests.text: Emily wants a taste of spring. She's asking for a fresh apricot.
quests.task: Bring Emily an Apricot.

quests.name: Aquatic Research
quests.text: Demetrius is studying the toxin levels of the local pufferfish. He'd like you to bring him one.
quests.task: Bring Demetrius a Pufferfish.

quests.name: A Soldier's Star
quests.text: Kent wants to give his wife a starfruit for their anniversary.
quests.task: Bring Kent a starfruit.

quests.name: Mayor's Need
quests.text: Mayor Lewis wants truffle oil. He won't explain what it's for. Maybe it's none of your business.
quests.task: Bring Lewis a bottle of Truffle Oil.

quests.name: Wanted: Lobster
quests.text: Gus put out a notice requesting a fresh lobster.
quests.task: Bring Gus a Lobster.

quests.name: Pam Needs Juice
quests.text: Pam's TV remote is dead. She's having a tough time going back and forth between the couch and the TV dial.
quests.task: Bring Pam a Battery Pack.

quests.name: Fish Casserole
quests.text: Jodi swung by the farm to ask you to dinner at 7:00 PM. Her only request was that you bring a Largemouth Bass for her fish casserole.
quests.start: Event - Jodi at 4 Hearts; Exit the Farmhouse between 6am and 9:30am on a Monday to trigger the event.
quests.task: Enter Jodi's house with a Largemouth Bass at 7:00 PM on any day after being invited (not a festival day).

quests.name: Catch a Squid
quests.text: Willy is challenging you to catch a squid. He says you can fish them from the ocean on winter nights.
quests.task: Bring Willy a Squid.

quests.name: Fish Stew
quests.text: Gus wants to make fish stew, but he needs an albacore.
quests.task: Bring Gus an Albacore.

quests.name: Pierre's Notice
quests.text: Pierre will pay "top coin" to whoever brings him a plate of sashimi. Apparently he's really craving the stuff.
quests.task: Bring Pierre some Sashimi.

quests.name: Clint's Attempt
quests.text: Clint wants you to give Emily an amethyst. He wants you to tell her it's from him.
quests.task: Bring Emily an Amethyst.

quests.name: A Favor For Clint
quests.text: Clint got a new hammer and he wants to test it out on a variety of metals.
quests.task: Bring Clint an Iron Bar.

quests.name: Staff of Power
quests.text: The Wizard is creating a staff of phenomenal power. Who knows what it's for. He needs an iridium bar to finish it.
quests.task: Bring Wizard an Iridium Bar.

quests.name: Granny's Gift
quests.text: Evelyn wants to surprise her husband with a gift.
quests.task: Bring Evelyn a Leek.

quests.name: Exotic Spirits
quests.text: Gus wants to make a Coco-no-no, but he's missing the main ingredient.
quests.task: Bring Gus a Coconut.

quests.name: Catch a Lingcod
quests.text: Willy is challenging you to catch a Lingcod.
quests.task: Bring Willy a Lingcod. (Does not have to be caught after accepting the quest)

quests.name: Dark Talisman
quests.text: The Wizard asked me to retrieve the magic ink from his ex-wife's house... but to gain access I'll need a dark talisman. Enter the sewer and ask Krobus about the dark talisman.
quests.start: Railroad cutscene (after completing Community Center or Joja Warehouse tasks).
quests.task: Speak to Krobus and then venture through to the Mutant Bug Lair to retrieve the talisman. Return to the cave at the Railroad with it once it's collected.

quests.name: Goblin Problem
quests.text: There's a goblin blocking the path to the Witch's Hut. There must be some way to get him to move... Perhaps I should seek out more information on Goblins.
quests.start: Through the cave by the Railroad after completing the Dark Talisman quest.
quests.task: Speak to the Henchman outside the Witch's hut and give him Void Mayonnaise as a gift. Take the Magic Ink from the Witch's Hut and give it to the Wizard.
quests.reward: Wizard buildings available. Dark shrines now accessible in Witch's Hut.

quests.name: The Pirate's Wife
quests.text: An old lady living on Ginger Island is asking you to find a keepsake of her husband's. She gave you an old photograph of a soldier that washed up on shore, hoping it would help in some way.
quests.task: Find a keepsake that belonged to Birdie's husband.

quests.name: The Giant Stump
quests.text: The big tree to the south of my farm blew down. With 100 hardwood, I could turn the stump into something interesting...
quests.start: Giant Stump in Cindersap Forest after the wind storm cutscene
quests.task: Fix the giant stump with 100 Hardwood.

raccoon.unlock: A strong wind storm can fell the big tree in Cindersap Forest: 10% chance each night once the Greenhouse is built. Repair the Giant Stump with 100 Hardwood.
raccoon.gap: A new request appears 7 days after the previous one is completed.

stages.task: 1 Dried Fruit + 1 Jelly of an in-season fruit
1 Dried Mushrooms + 5 eggs, Cave Carrots or White Algae
1 Pickles + 1 Juice of an in-season vegetable
2 random items, e.g. 20 Bat Wing, 4 Coral, 8 Geodes, 3 Ghostfish, 10 Moss
Repeats one of the first five requests at random

rod.text: Willy gives you a Bamboo Pole on Spring 2 (Year 1) when you visit the beach — no fishing before that.

fishShop.text: Willy's shop is open 9am–5pm; closed Saturdays unless it's raining.

pierre.text: Pierre's is open 9am–5pm and closed on Wednesdays until the Community Center is restored.

joja.text: JojaMart sells seeds at a 25% markup unless you buy a Joja membership; it closes for good once the Community Center is restored.

cart.text: The Traveling Cart visits Cindersap Forest on Fridays and Sundays, 6am–8pm, plus every day of the Night Market (Winter 15–17) and Desert Festival (Spring 15–17). Stock is random.

railroad.text: The Railroad opens after the earthquake on Summer 3, Year 1.

woods.text: The Secret Woods are behind a large log in Cindersap Forest; you need a Steel Axe to cut it.

sewer.text: The Sewers need the Rusty Key, which Gunther mails you after 60 museum donations.

bus.text: The bus to the Desert is repaired by the Vault bundles (or the Joja form, 40,000g).

skull.text: Skull Cavern needs the Skull Key (Mines floor 120) and the bus to the Desert.

island.text: Willy's boat to Ginger Island needs the Community Center (or Joja) finished, then 200 Hardwood, 5 Iridium Bars and 5 Battery Packs; tickets are 1,000g.

greenhouse.text: The Greenhouse is restored by the Pantry bundles (or the Joja form, 35,000g).

orders.text: The Special Orders board next to Pierre's opens on Fall 2, Year 1.

qi.text: Qi's Walnut Room opens after collecting 100 Golden Walnuts.

kegJar.text: Preserves Jar recipe at Farming level 4, Keg at Farming level 8.

artisan.text: Wine sells for 3× the fruit; Juice 2.25× the vegetable; Jelly/Pickles 2× + 50g.

helpWanted.text: The Help Wanted board outside Pierre's may post a random request every day except the first day; delivery requests pay 3× the item's price.

rain.text: Rain waters your crops for you, and some fish only bite in rain. Storms and Green Rain count as rain; windy and snowy days count as dry.

mineFloors.text: Mine fish: Ghostfish & Stonefish from floor 20, Ice Pip from floor 60, Lava Eel from floor 100.

greenRain.text: Green Rain happens once each Summer, on one of these days: 5, 6, 7, 14, 15, 16, 18 or 23. It covers about half of all grown trees in Moss, spawns large weeds worth 15 Foraging XP each, and farm Green Rain Trees can give Mossy Seeds.

greenRainY1.text: In Year 1, most villagers stay indoors during Green Rain (except Demetrius, Leah and Linus) and you can't give gifts.

fixedWeather.text: Always sunny on the 1st of Spring, Summer, Fall and Winter and on festival days; in Year 1, Spring 2, 4 and 5 are sunny and Spring 3 rains. Snow only falls in Winter (it never rains then), windy days only happen in Spring and Fall, and Spring has no storms in Year 1.

mines.text: The Mines are blocked by a rockslide until Spring 5, Year 1. Every 5th floor is an elevator stop; floor 120 gives the Skull Key.

backpack.text: Pierre sells the Large Pack (24 slots) for 2,000g and the Deluxe Pack (36 slots) for 10,000g.

tools.text: Clint upgrades tools in 2 days: Copper 2,000g + 5 Copper Bars, Steel 5,000g + 5 Iron Bars, Gold 10,000g + 5 Gold Bars, Iridium 25,000g + 5 Iridium Bars.

house.text: Robin's first house upgrade (kitchen) costs 10,000g + 450 Wood; the second 65,000g + 100 Hardwood; the cellar 100,000g.

crabPot.text: Crab Pots unlock at Fishing level 3 (craft them or buy from Willy for 1,500g).

storm.text: It is always stormy on Summer 13 and 26. Storms count as rain; lightning can hit your farm, and Lightning Rods (Foraging level 6) turn strikes into Battery Packs.
